svg.title: One assembler's panel: fiducials and labels that can't be mistaken
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, the top and the bottom of a 150 by 110 mm panel of four 60 by 40 mm boards, with 10 mm rails on all four sides and between the boards. Each side has three fiducials on the short-edge rails, centered in the rail and 15 mm from the long edges: 1 mm at the upper left, 2 mm at the lower left and 3 mm at the lower right. They are round on the top side and square on the bottom side, as the enlarged row below shows. The rail along the long edge opposite the 2 and 3 mm fiducials carries the side, Top or Bottom, and the board's part number in silkscreen.
